title: Terraform pre-install assertion scan for Private VPC installs
creator: Maya Chen
description: Implement a deterministic pre-install assertion scan that runs before Terraform apply for Private (VPC) installs. The goal is to surface configuration and quota issues early with clear remediation steps so customers and SREs avoid failed installs and long iteration cycles. The validator will be implemented as a Terraform external data provider + a lightweight CLI/checker so it can be run locally, in CI, and as a preflight job in our onboarding operator. Scope includes cloud quotas (vCPU, GPUs, IPs), IAM/principal permissions for state and resources, DNS zone/delegation checks, network peering/vpc limits, S3/GCS backend permissions and encryption, and GPU availability/driver compatibility guidance. This ticket focuses on the assertion catalog, checks implementation plan, and the terraform hook integration; separate follow-ups will add provider-specific implementations and UI surface in Console.
acceptance_criteria: A reusable checklist of preflight assertions exists and is reviewed by Infra and Security
A Terraform external data provider prototype implemented that runs the assertion set and returns structured error codes
Pre-install run returns actionable remediation messages for at least AWS and GCP covering quotas, IAM, DNS, and GPU instance availability
CI job added that runs the validator against a sample Private install plan and fails on critical assertions
Documentation and runbook links added for remedial steps and known cloud quota escalation paths
checklist_steps: Draft assertion catalog: quotas, IAM, DNS, networking, storage backend, KMS/keys, GPU node prerequisites
Define error taxonomy: critical | warning | info and remediation hints
Prototype Terraform external provider that shells out to checker binary and returns codes
Implement AWS quota queries (EC2 vCPU, GPU instance family, EIP limits, ENI limits)
Implement GCP quota queries (compute.googleapis.com/CPUs, GPUs, static IPs, regional quotas)
Add IAM preflight: required policies for state bucket, service accounts, node bootstrap roles
DNS checks: authoritative zone exists, NS delegation, private zone visibility to target VPCs
Network checks: VPC peering compatibility, CIDR overlap, route table capacity, subnet IP availability
GPU checks: desired instance types available in region, driver/MIG support notes, recommended fallback shapes
S3/GCS backend: encryption enabled, lifecycle/lock checks, backend access from CI/service account
Integrate checker into our onboarding operator as a preflight gate (opt-in) and Terraform pre-apply hook
Add CI smoke to private-deploy pipeline with sample plan and remedial message validation
Write runbook and KB entries for common quota increase requests per cloud
notes: Decision: prototype as a language-agnostic binary + terraform external data provider so teams can reuse without deep Terraform SDK work
Trade-off: external provider adds an extra binary surface but reduces development time vs writing a native provider
We will prioritize AWS and GCP for MVP; Azure follow-up depends on demand and account model differences
Consider adding soft-fail for low-severity warnings to allow installs while surfacing risks
Need to coordinate with Solutions Eng to include customer-specific quota checks for enterprise onboarding
